required_changes.requirement: Construct each model observation from training pairs with their outputs plus test inputs only. The collector must never place task.test outputs, expected grids, scoring fields, program labels, or any other held-out answer material into the tokenizer input. Add a regression test that fails if any test-output bytes or canonical grid representation appear in the prompt.

Freeze the exact observation-only ARC-native prompt serializer, tokenizer/config hashes, special tokens, attention backend, deterministic generation settings, maximum output length, termination rule, output extraction, canonical ARC grid parser, and invalid-output policy. Reuse an already validated stage-compatible evaluator only if its exact source and configuration hashes are bound into the new package.

For every frozen TARGET_DEV and RETENTION_SENTINEL episode, define an immutable output row containing episode identity, observation hash, canonical prediction hash, parse-valid status, exact-grid-match outcome, model/base manifest identity, and inference-contract identity. Freeze aggregate surface counts and the base-side outcomes needed for later paired n01/n10 comparison. Do not access FINAL_AUDIT.

Enforce the declared runtime limit with a monotonic deadline checked before each generation and after each completed episode. On the cap or any failure, atomically save a partial non-pass receipt, record completed episode identities, release the model, and stop. A partial or capped run must never emit COLLECTED_PASS. Baseline inference time must be recorded separately from the cumulative GPU-training ledger and must not be represented as optimizer training time.

Before model loading, fail closed unless every expected base shard, index, tokenizer, config, and manifest file matches the V5 launch binding. Freeze the resolved GPU device, BF16 support requirement, explicit model and tensor device placement, no-LoRA/no-optimizer assertions, and a runtime receipt proving optimizer_constructed=false and scientific_training_started=false.

Run CPU-only tests covering observation redaction, prompt/token identities, deterministic episode order, parser-valid and parser-invalid outputs, duplicate or missing episode rejection, incorrect base or data hash rejection, output-path non-overwrite, runtime-cap partial receipt, forbidden TRAIN and FINAL_AUDIT path rejection, and authorization-field fail-closed behavior. Freeze the test report and hashes.

Create an additive execution-contract revision with the corrected collector, resolved command, source hashes, output and receipt paths, inference contract, test evidence, V5 canonical ledger declaration, and complete read-only preflight. The preflight must run on the exact final commit and complete before any model import or load.

Commit and push the additive remediation on the existing non-main branch without force-push or frozen-history rewrite, verify fresh local HEAD equals git ls-remote origin SHA equals RunPod checked-out/source SHA, and submit a new hashed brief requesting baseline-reference collection authorization only.
